title: Brief section parser ends a section at an empty level-2 heading
body: Outcome: src/brief/sections.ts treats a bare '##' line as a level-2 heading that closes the active section, so '## Allowed paths / src/a.ts / ## / notes' yields only src/a.ts. Evidence: PR #192 review record 2 NON_BLOCKING (review-series d9d12458…/records/2.json). Proof: a case in test/brief/allowed-paths.test.ts red at base by assertion.
